law.q: Who built a big ark at God's command?
law.explain: God told Noah to make an ark (Genesis 6:14).

law.q: What did God create on the very first day?
law.explain: God said, 'Let there be light' on the first day (Genesis 1:3-5).

law.q: What did God put in the sky as a promise after the flood?
law.explain: God set His bow in the cloud as a sign of His promise (Genesis 9:13).

law.q: Who was given a special coat of many colors by his father?
law.explain: Jacob made Joseph a coat of many colors (Genesis 37:3).

law.q: Who was the first man God made?
law.explain: God formed Adam from the dust of the ground (Genesis 2:7).

law.q: Where did Moses' mother hide baby Moses by the river?
law.explain: She made a basket of reeds and placed him in it by the river (Exodus 2:3).

law.q: What bread-like food did God send from heaven each morning in the desert?
law.explain: The people called the bread from heaven manna (Exodus 16:31).

law.q: What did God write on two stone tablets for Moses?
law.explain: God gave Moses two tablets written by His finger (Exodus 31:18; 20).

law.q: What sea did God part so Israel could walk through on dry ground?
law.explain: The LORD made the sea go back and Israel crossed on dry ground (Exodus 14:21-22).

law.q: What did Moses see that was burning but did not burn up?
law.explain: The bush burned with fire but was not consumed (Exodus 3:2).

law.q: Who was the son God promised to Abraham and Sarah?
law.explain: Abraham named his son born to Sarah Isaac (Genesis 21:3).

law.q: What bird did Noah send out that came back with an olive leaf?
law.explain: The dove returned with an olive leaf in its mouth (Genesis 8:11).

law.q: Who was the first woman God made?
law.explain: God made the woman and brought her to Adam; she was named Eve (Genesis 2:22; 3:20).

law.q: What did God do on the seventh day of creation?
law.explain: On the seventh day God rested from His work (Genesis 2:2).

law.q: In what garden did God place Adam and Eve?
law.explain: God planted a garden in Eden and put the man there (Genesis 2:8).

law.q: What did Jacob see in his dream, with angels going up and down?
law.explain: Jacob dreamed of a ladder set on the earth reaching to heaven (Genesis 28:12).

law.q: Who was Moses' brother who spoke for him to Pharaoh?
law.explain: God said Aaron would speak for Moses (Exodus 4:14-16).

law.q: How many plagues did God send on Egypt?
law.explain: Ten plagues struck Egypt, from the Nile turning to blood to the death of the firstborn (Exodus 7-12).

law.q: Who interpreted Pharaoh's dreams about seven fat and seven thin cows?
law.explain: Joseph told Pharaoh God had shown him what He was about to do (Genesis 41:25).

law.q: Who sold his birthright for a bowl of stew?
law.explain: Esau swore to Jacob and sold his birthright (Genesis 25:29-34).

law.q: For which woman did Jacob first agree to work seven years?
law.explain: Jacob loved Rachel and offered to serve seven years for her (Genesis 29:18).

law.q: Which book of the Law tells of Israel leaving Egypt?
law.explain: On that day the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt (Exodus 12:51).

law.q: What did God provide in place of Isaac on the mountain?
law.explain: Abraham saw a ram caught in a thicket and offered it instead (Genesis 22:13).

law.q: On which mountain did God give the Ten Commandments?
law.explain: The LORD came down on Mount Sinai and spoke His commandments (Exodus 19:20; 20).

law.q: Who became Israel's leader after Moses died?
law.explain: Joshua was filled with the spirit of wisdom after Moses laid hands on him (Deuteronomy 34:9).

law.q: What idol did the Israelites make while Moses was on the mountain?
law.explain: Aaron fashioned a golden calf from the people's gold (Exodus 32:4).

law.q: What did Moses lift on a pole so bitten Israelites could look and live?
law.explain: Whoever looked at the bronze serpent lived (Numbers 21:9).

law.q: Who was killed by his brother Cain?
law.explain: Cain rose up against his brother Abel and killed him (Genesis 4:8).

law.q: Which two spies gave a faithful report about the land of Canaan?
law.explain: Joshua and Caleb urged Israel to trust God and take the land (Numbers 14:6-9).

law.q: What did God confuse at the Tower of Babel?
law.explain: God confused their language so they could not understand one another (Genesis 11:7).

law.q: To which land was Joseph taken after his brothers sold him?
law.explain: The Midianites sold Joseph in Egypt to Potiphar (Genesis 37:36).

law.q: Which of these happened first in Genesis?
law.explain: The flood (Genesis 6-9) comes before Babel (11), Isaac's birth (21) and Joseph's sale (37).

law.q: Finish the verse: 'In the beginning God created the heaven and the ___.'
law.explain: Genesis 1:1 opens the Bible with God creating heaven and earth.

law.q: Deuteronomy 6:4 begins 'Hear, O Israel.' What does it say about the LORD our God?
law.explain: The Shema declares that the LORD our God is one (Deuteronomy 6:4).

law.q: In the priestly blessing, what is asked of the LORD right after 'bless'?
law.explain: The priestly blessing asks the LORD to bless and keep His people (Numbers 6:24).

law.q: What was credited to Abram when he believed the LORD?
law.explain: Abram believed the LORD, and it was counted to him as righteousness (Genesis 15:6).

law.q: Who was the priest-king of Salem who blessed Abram?
law.explain: Melchizedek, king of Salem and priest of God Most High, blessed Abram (Genesis 14:18-19).

law.q: What spoke to the prophet Balaam when it saw the angel of the LORD?
law.explain: The LORD opened the donkey's mouth to speak to Balaam (Numbers 22:28).

law.q: Which book gives the instructions for the Day of Atonement?
law.explain: Leviticus 16 describes the yearly Day of Atonement.

law.q: From which mountain did Moses view the Promised Land before he died?
law.explain: Moses went up Mount Nebo and the LORD showed him the land (Deuteronomy 34:1).

law.q: What was the tenth and final plague on Egypt?
law.explain: At midnight the LORD struck down the firstborn in Egypt (Exodus 12:29).

law.q: Whose staff budded and bore almonds, showing God's chosen priesthood?
law.explain: Aaron's rod for the house of Levi budded and bore ripe almonds (Numbers 17:8).

history.q: Who led God's people as they marched around the walls of Jericho?
history.explain: Joshua led Israel around Jericho, as told in Joshua 6.

history.q: What happened to the walls of Jericho after the people shouted?
history.explain: Joshua 6:20 says the wall fell down flat when the people shouted.

history.q: Which giant did young David defeat?
history.explain: David defeated the giant Goliath, as told in 1 Samuel 17.

history.q: What did David use to defeat Goliath?
history.explain: 1 Samuel 17:50 says David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and a stone.

history.q: Which man's great strength was linked to his long hair?
history.explain: Samson's strength was tied to his uncut hair, as told in Judges 16.

history.q: Who told Naomi, "Your people shall be my people"?
history.explain: Ruth stayed loyal to Naomi and spoke these words in Ruth 1:16.

history.q: Which brave woman became queen and helped save her people?
history.explain: Queen Esther risked her life to help the Jews, as told in Esther 4.

history.q: Whom did Ruth marry in Bethlehem?
history.explain: Ruth 4:13 says Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife.

history.q: Who was the first king of Israel?
history.explain: Samuel anointed Saul as Israel's first king in 1 Samuel 10.

history.q: Which young boy heard God calling his name at night?
history.explain: God called the boy Samuel in the night, as told in 1 Samuel 3.

history.q: Which king asked God for wisdom?
history.explain: Solomon asked God for an understanding heart in 1 Kings 3.

history.q: What did King Solomon build for God in Jerusalem?
history.explain: Solomon built the temple for the LORD, as described in 1 Kings 6.

history.q: Which prophet was fed bread and meat by ravens?
history.explain: 1 Kings 17:6 says ravens brought Elijah bread and meat.

history.q: Who prayed for a baby boy and later had a son named Samuel?
history.explain: Hannah prayed for a child and God gave her Samuel, in 1 Samuel 1.

history.q: What did Gideon's men blow, with jars and torches, to scare the enemy?
history.explain: Gideon's men blew trumpets and broke their jars in Judges 7:19-20.

history.q: Which shepherd boy was chosen by God to become king?
history.explain: Samuel anointed the shepherd boy David in 1 Samuel 16.

history.q: Who took over leadership of Israel after Moses died?
history.explain: Joshua 1:1-2 shows the LORD commissioning Joshua after Moses' death.

history.q: Who hid the Israelite spies in Jericho?
history.explain: Rahab hid the two spies on her roof in Joshua 2.

history.q: Which river did Israel cross to enter the Promised Land?
history.explain: The people crossed the Jordan on dry ground in Joshua 3.

history.q: Which judge defeated the Midianites with a small army of 300 men?
history.explain: God reduced Gideon's army to 300 men for victory in Judges 7.

history.q: Which woman was a judge and prophetess who served alongside Barak?
history.explain: Judges 4 describes Deborah judging Israel and going with Barak to battle.

history.q: Who was Saul's son and David's closest friend?
history.explain: 1 Samuel 18:1-3 says Jonathan loved David and made a covenant with him.

history.q: Which prophet confronted David about his sin with Bathsheba?
history.explain: Nathan told David "You are the man" in 2 Samuel 12.

history.q: Which son of David led a rebellion that forced David to flee Jerusalem?
history.explain: Absalom won the people's hearts and rebelled against David in 2 Samuel 15.

history.q: On which mountain did Elijah challenge the prophets of Baal?
history.explain: Elijah called down fire at Mount Carmel in 1 Kings 18.

history.q: Who became the prophet after Elijah was taken up to heaven?
history.explain: Elisha received Elijah's mantle in 2 Kings 2.

history.q: Which Syrian commander was healed of leprosy after washing in the Jordan?
history.explain: Naaman was healed after washing seven times in the Jordan, 2 Kings 5.

history.q: Who led the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls?
history.explain: Nehemiah got permission and led the wall rebuilding in Nehemiah 2-6.

history.q: Which official plotted to destroy the Jews in the book of Esther?
history.explain: Haman plotted against the Jews in Esther 3.

history.q: In which valley did David face Goliath?
history.explain: 1 Samuel 17:2 places Israel's camp in the Valley of Elah.

history.q: Which quality did the LORD urge Joshua to have in Joshua 1:9?
history.explain: The LORD encourages Joshua in Joshua 1:9 to be of good courage.

history.q: 1 Samuel 16:7 (KJV): "...man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the ____."
history.explain: God told Samuel in 1 Samuel 16:7 that He looks on the heart.

history.q: Joshua 24:15 (KJV): "As for me and my house, we will ____ the LORD."
history.explain: Joshua declared that he and his house would serve the LORD, Joshua 24:15.

history.q: Who was the first judge to deliver Israel after the people forgot the LORD?
history.explain: Judges 3:9 says the LORD raised up Othniel as a deliverer.

history.q: Which king began reforms after the Book of the Law was found in the temple?
history.explain: 2 Kings 22 tells how Hilkiah found the Book of the Law during Josiah's reign.

history.q: Which king prayed after Isaiah said he would die, and was healed?
history.explain: Hezekiah prayed and the LORD added to his days, 2 Kings 20.

history.q: Which Persian king issued the decree allowing the Jews to return and rebuild the temple?
history.explain: Ezra 1:1-3 records Cyrus' decree to rebuild the house of the LORD.

history.q: Which priest and scribe taught the Law to the returned exiles?
history.explain: Ezra 7 describes Ezra as a scribe skilled in the Law of Moses.

history.q: Who raised Esther as his own daughter?
history.explain: Esther 2:7 says Mordecai brought up Esther, his cousin.

history.q: Which priest's sons Hophni and Phinehas died in the battle where the ark was captured?
history.explain: 1 Samuel 4 records the death of Eli's sons and the ark's capture.

history.q: Whose harsh answer led ten tribes to break away from the house of David?
history.explain: Rehoboam rejected the elders' counsel and the kingdom divided, 1 Kings 12.

history.q: Whose wife was Bathsheba before David took her?
history.explain: 2 Samuel 11 identifies Bathsheba as the wife of Uriah the Hittite.

history.q: Which book comes directly after Ruth in the Old Testament?
history.explain: Ruth is followed by 1 Samuel, which opens with Hannah and Samuel.

wisdom.q: The LORD is my ___.
wisdom.explain: Psalm 23:1 begins, 'The LORD is my shepherd.'

wisdom.q: Thy word is a lamp unto my ___.
wisdom.explain: Psalm 119:105 says God's word is a lamp unto my feet.

wisdom.q: Trust in the LORD with all thine ___.
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 3:5 says to trust in the LORD with all your heart.

wisdom.q: God is our refuge and ___.
wisdom.explain: Psalm 46:1 says God is our refuge and strength.

wisdom.q: Be still, and know that I am ___.
wisdom.explain: Psalm 46:10 says, 'Be still, and know that I am God.'

wisdom.q: This is the day the LORD has made; we will ___ and be glad in it.
wisdom.explain: Psalm 118:24 says we will rejoice and be glad in it.

wisdom.q: A soft (gentle) answer turns away ___.
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 15:1 says a soft answer turns away wrath.

wisdom.q: Which shepherd boy who became king wrote most of the Psalms?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 3:1 is titled 'A Psalm of David,' and many Psalms carry his name.

wisdom.q: Which wise king wrote many of the Proverbs?
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 1:1 says 'The proverbs of Solomon the son of David.'

wisdom.q: Which patient man trusted God even after losing so much?
wisdom.explain: In Job 1:21 Job said, 'Blessed be the name of the LORD.'

wisdom.q: In Psalm 23, what does the LORD make me do in green pastures?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 23:2 says He makes me lie down in green pastures.

wisdom.q: In Psalm 23, the LORD leads me beside what kind of waters?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 23:2 says He leads me beside the still waters.

wisdom.q: Train up a child in the way he should ___.
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 22:6 says to train up a child in the way he should go.

wisdom.q: A merry heart does good like a ___.
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 17:22 says a merry heart does good like a medicine.

wisdom.q: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no ___.
wisdom.explain: Psalm 23:4 says, 'I will fear no evil: for thou art with me.'

wisdom.q: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not ___ against thee.
wisdom.explain: Psalm 119:11 says the word is hidden in the heart so that I might not sin against God.

wisdom.q: Create in me a clean heart, O ___.
wisdom.explain: Psalm 51:10 says, 'Create in me a clean heart, O God.'

wisdom.q: Delight thyself also in the LORD, and he shall give thee the desires of thine ___.
wisdom.explain: Psalm 37:4 promises the desires of your heart to those who delight in the LORD.

wisdom.q: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a ___.
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 16:18 warns that a haughty spirit comes before a fall.

wisdom.q: To every thing there is a ___, and a time to every purpose under the heaven.
wisdom.explain: Ecclesiastes 3:1 says to every thing there is a season.

wisdom.q: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy ___.
wisdom.explain: Ecclesiastes 12:1 urges us to remember our Creator in the days of our youth.

wisdom.q: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his ___.
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 27:17 says a man sharpens the countenance of his friend.

wisdom.q: Which man was one of the three friends who came to comfort Job?
wisdom.explain: Job 2:11 names Eliphaz, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar as Job's three friends.

wisdom.q: In what land did Job live?
wisdom.explain: Job 1:1 says there was a man in the land of Uz whose name was Job.

wisdom.q: How many sons did Job have at the beginning of the story?
wisdom.explain: Job 1:2 says seven sons and three daughters were born to him.

wisdom.q: Which Psalm is the shortest chapter in the Bible?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 117 has only two verses, starting at Psalm 117:1.

wisdom.q: Which Psalm is the longest chapter in the Bible?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 119 runs to 176 verses, ending at Psalm 119:176.

wisdom.q: In which book do we read, 'To every thing there is a season'?
wisdom.explain: The famous 'season' passage opens Ecclesiastes 3:1.

wisdom.q: Which book of poetry comes right after Job in the Bible?
wisdom.explain: Psalms follows Job, beginning at Psalm 1:1.

wisdom.q: A good name is rather to be chosen than great ___.
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 22:1 says a good name is rather to be chosen than great riches.

wisdom.q: The LORD is my light and my ___.
wisdom.explain: Psalm 27:1 begins, 'The LORD is my light and my salvation.'

wisdom.q: In Job 19:25, Job declares that who lives?
wisdom.explain: Job 19:25 says, 'I know that my Redeemer lives.'

wisdom.q: When the LORD restored Job, how much did He give him compared to what he had before?
wisdom.explain: Job 42:10 says the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.

wisdom.q: Out of what did the LORD answer Job?
wisdom.explain: Job 38:1 says the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind.

wisdom.q: Which book contains the saying 'Vanity of vanities, all is vanity'?
wisdom.explain: Ecclesiastes 1:2 opens with 'Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.'

wisdom.q: Who can find a virtuous ___? for her price is far above rubies.
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 31:10 opens the praise of the virtuous woman.

wisdom.q: Who is named as the speaker of the words in Proverbs 30?
wisdom.explain: Proverbs 30:1 names 'the words of Agur the son of Jakeh.'

wisdom.q: In Song of Solomon 2:1, which flower of the valleys is named alongside the rose of Sharon?
wisdom.explain: Song of Solomon 2:1 pairs the rose of Sharon with the lily of the valleys.

wisdom.q: By the rivers of what city did the exiles sit down and weep?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 137:1 says, 'By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down.'

wisdom.q: Which man of God is credited with the prayer in Psalm 90?
wisdom.explain: Psalm 90 is titled 'A Prayer of Moses the man of God.'

wisdom.q: Fear God, and keep his ___: for this is the whole duty of man.
wisdom.explain: Ecclesiastes 12:13 says to fear God and keep his commandments.

majorprophets.q: Who was thrown into the den of lions for praying to God?
majorprophets.explain: Daniel kept praying to God and was put in the lions' den (Daniel 6).

majorprophets.q: Who shut the lions' mouths so they could not hurt Daniel?
majorprophets.explain: Daniel said God sent His angel and shut the lions' mouths (Daniel 6:22).

majorprophets.q: Who was the king who loved Daniel and hoped God would save him from the lions?
majorprophets.explain: King Darius told Daniel that his God would deliver him (Daniel 6:16).

majorprophets.q: What did Daniel do three times every day, even when it was against the law?
majorprophets.explain: Daniel knelt and prayed three times a day (Daniel 6:10).

majorprophets.q: What did Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego refuse to bow down to?
majorprophets.explain: They would only worship God, not the golden image (Daniel 3).

majorprophets.q: Where were Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego thrown, and God kept them safe?
majorprophets.explain: God kept them safe in the fiery furnace; they were not burned (Daniel 3).

majorprophets.q: Which king set up the big golden statue?
majorprophets.explain: King Nebuchadnezzar made the image of gold (Daniel 3:1).

majorprophets.q: How many friends of Daniel were put in the fiery furnace?
majorprophets.explain: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, three friends, were in the furnace (Daniel 3).

majorprophets.q: What did Daniel and his friends ask to eat instead of the king's rich food?
majorprophets.explain: Daniel asked for vegetables and water, and they grew healthy (Daniel 1:12-15).

majorprophets.q: In Daniel 5, what appeared and wrote words on the palace wall?
majorprophets.explain: Fingers of a man's hand wrote on the wall (Daniel 5:5).

majorprophets.q: Which book of the Bible tells the story of Daniel in the lions' den?
majorprophets.explain: The lions' den story is in Daniel chapter 6.

majorprophets.q: Finish the verse: "For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is ___."
majorprophets.explain: Isaiah 9:6 says unto us a son is given.

majorprophets.q: In Isaiah 40:31, those who wait on the Lord will rise up like which bird?
majorprophets.explain: Isaiah 40:31 promises those who wait on the Lord will rise up like eagles.

majorprophets.q: One name for Jesus in Isaiah 9:6 is "Prince of ___."
majorprophets.explain: Isaiah 9:6 calls Him the Prince of Peace.

majorprophets.q: Finish the verse: "The wolf will live with the ___."
majorprophets.explain: Isaiah 11:6 describes peace where the wolf lives with the lamb.

majorprophets.q: Finish the verse: "His mercies are new every ___."
majorprophets.explain: Lamentations 3:23 says God's mercies are new every morning.

majorprophets.q: Which prophet answered God, "Here am I; send me"?
majorprophets.explain: Isaiah said "Here am I; send me" in Isaiah 6:8.

majorprophets.q: Which book contains the Suffering Servant passage that says "by his stripes we are healed"?
majorprophets.explain: Isaiah 53:5 speaks of the Servant wounded for our transgressions.

majorprophets.q: In Isaiah 7:14, what name is given to the child born of a virgin?
majorprophets.explain: Isaiah 7:14 names the child Immanuel, meaning God with us.

majorprophets.q: What were the heavenly creatures with six wings in Isaiah's vision of the temple called?
majorprophets.explain: Seraphim stood above the Lord, each with six wings (Isaiah 6:2).

majorprophets.q: To the exiles in which city did Jeremiah send the letter containing "plans to give you hope and a future"?
majorprophets.explain: Jeremiah wrote to the exiles in Babylon (Jeremiah 29).

majorprophets.q: Who was Jeremiah's scribe who wrote down his words on a scroll?
majorprophets.explain: Baruch wrote Jeremiah's words on a scroll (Jeremiah 36:4).

majorprophets.q: Who rescued Jeremiah from the muddy cistern?
majorprophets.explain: Ebed-melech the Ethiopian pulled Jeremiah out with ropes (Jeremiah 38).

majorprophets.q: Whom did God have Jeremiah go watch at work to learn about being shaped by God?
majorprophets.explain: God sent Jeremiah to the potter's house (Jeremiah 18).

majorprophets.q: What filled the valley in Ezekiel's famous vision that God brought back to life?
majorprophets.explain: Ezekiel saw a valley full of dry bones come to life (Ezekiel 37).

majorprophets.q: What role did God give Ezekiel for the house of Israel?
majorprophets.explain: God made Ezekiel a watchman for Israel (Ezekiel 3:17).

majorprophets.q: Whose dream of a statue with a head of gold did Daniel explain?
majorprophets.explain: Daniel interpreted Nebuchadnezzar's dream of the statue (Daniel 2).

majorprophets.q: In Nebuchadnezzar's dream, what was the statue's head made of?
majorprophets.explain: The head of the statue was fine gold (Daniel 2:32).

majorprophets.q: Which king was feasting when the hand wrote on the wall?
majorprophets.explain: King Belshazzar held the feast when the writing appeared (Daniel 5).

majorprophets.q: What Babylonian name was given to Daniel?
majorprophets.explain: The chief official renamed Daniel Belteshazzar (Daniel 1:7).

majorprophets.q: What Babylonian name was given to Hananiah?
majorprophets.explain: Hananiah was renamed Shadrach (Daniel 1:7).

majorprophets.q: Which city's fall and destruction does the book of Lamentations mourn?
majorprophets.explain: Lamentations grieves over the ruined Jerusalem (Lamentations 1).

majorprophets.q: By which river was Ezekiel among the exiles when he saw visions of God?
majorprophets.explain: Ezekiel was by the river Chebar (Ezekiel 1:1).

majorprophets.q: Which Persian king does Isaiah name as the Lord's anointed, long before he was born?
majorprophets.explain: Isaiah 45:1 calls Cyrus the Lord's anointed.

majorprophets.q: Which Assyrian king sent his commander to threaten Jerusalem in King Hezekiah's days?
majorprophets.explain: Sennacherib king of Assyria came against Judah's cities (Isaiah 36:1).

majorprophets.q: In the year which king died did Isaiah see the Lord seated on a throne?
majorprophets.explain: Isaiah's vision came in the year King Uzziah died (Isaiah 6:1).

majorprophets.q: What was the hometown of Jeremiah, a priest's son?
majorprophets.explain: Jeremiah was of the priests in Anathoth (Jeremiah 1:1).

majorprophets.q: How many years did Jeremiah say Judah would serve Babylon before the Lord visited them?
majorprophets.explain: Jeremiah 29:10 speaks of seventy years for Babylon.

majorprophets.q: Which angel came to Daniel in swift flight at the time of the evening offering to give him understanding?
majorprophets.explain: Gabriel came to Daniel to give him insight (Daniel 9:21-22).

majorprophets.q: In Ezekiel's vision of the life-giving river, from where did the water flow?
majorprophets.explain: Water flowed out from under the threshold of the temple (Ezekiel 47:1).

majorprophets.q: Finish the verse: "Great is your ___." (Lamentations 3)
majorprophets.explain: Lamentations 3:23 says great is your faithfulness.

majorprophets.q: Which book comes right after Lamentations in the Bible?
majorprophets.explain: Ezekiel follows Lamentations, and Daniel follows Ezekiel.

minorprophets.q: Who was swallowed by a great fish?
minorprophets.explain: The LORD prepared a great fish to swallow Jonah (Jonah 1:17).

minorprophets.q: What swallowed Jonah?
minorprophets.explain: Jonah 1:17 says God prepared a great fish to swallow Jonah.

minorprophets.q: How long was Jonah inside the great fish?
minorprophets.explain: Jonah was in the fish three days and three nights (Jonah 1:17).

minorprophets.q: To which big city did God tell Jonah to go?
minorprophets.explain: God said, 'Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city' (Jonah 1:2).

minorprophets.q: Which faraway place did Jonah sail toward, instead of obeying God?
minorprophets.explain: Jonah rose up to flee to Tarshish from the LORD (Jonah 1:3).

minorprophets.q: At which seaport did Jonah get on a ship?
minorprophets.explain: Jonah went down to Joppa and found a ship (Jonah 1:3).

minorprophets.q: What did Jonah get on at Joppa to sail away?
minorprophets.explain: Jonah found a ship going to Tarshish (Jonah 1:3).

minorprophets.q: What did the LORD send on the sea while Jonah was on the ship?
minorprophets.explain: The LORD sent out a great wind on the sea (Jonah 1:4).

minorprophets.q: Who prepared the great fish for Jonah?
minorprophets.explain: Jonah 1:17 says the LORD had prepared a great fish.

minorprophets.q: Where was Jonah when he prayed to God?
minorprophets.explain: Jonah prayed to the LORD his God out of the fish's belly (Jonah 2:1).

minorprophets.q: Where did the fish put Jonah when God spoke to it?
minorprophets.explain: The LORD spoke to the fish, and it put Jonah out on dry land (Jonah 2:10).

minorprophets.q: How did the people of Nineveh respond to God's message through Jonah?
minorprophets.explain: The people of Nineveh believed God (Jonah 3:5).

minorprophets.q: What did God make grow up over Jonah to give him shade?
minorprophets.explain: God prepared a plant to come up over Jonah as shade (Jonah 4:6).

minorprophets.q: Which book of the Bible tells about a great fish?
minorprophets.explain: The great fish is in the book of Jonah (Jonah 1:17).

minorprophets.q: The prophet Micah said a ruler would come from which little town?
minorprophets.explain: Micah 5:2 names Bethlehem Ephrathah.

minorprophets.q: Which book is the very last in the Old Testament?
minorprophets.explain: Malachi is the final book; its last verse is Malachi 4:6.

minorprophets.q: Which prophet foretold that a ruler would come out of Bethlehem Ephrathah?
minorprophets.explain: Micah 5:2 names Bethlehem as the ruler's birthplace.

minorprophets.q: Micah 6:8: 'to do justly, to love mercy, and to walk ___ with your God.'
minorprophets.explain: Micah 6:8 says to walk humbly with your God.

minorprophets.q: Whom did the prophet Hosea marry at God's command?
minorprophets.explain: Hosea took Gomer, daughter of Diblaim (Hosea 1:3).

minorprophets.q: Joel 2:28: 'I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh; your sons and daughters shall ___.'
minorprophets.explain: Joel 2:28 says your sons and daughters shall prophesy.

minorprophets.q: Which prophet was a herdsman and a gatherer of sycamore figs?
minorprophets.explain: Amos said he was a herdsman and a tender of sycamore figs (Amos 7:14).

minorprophets.q: Which prophet's short book is a vision against Edom?
minorprophets.explain: Obadiah 1:1 begins, 'Thus says the Lord GOD concerning Edom.'

minorprophets.q: Habakkuk 2:4: 'The just (righteous) shall live by his ___.'
minorprophets.explain: Habakkuk 2:4 says the just shall live by his faith.

minorprophets.q: Zechariah 4:6: 'Not by might, nor by power, but by my ___, says the LORD of hosts.'
minorprophets.explain: Zechariah 4:6 says 'but by my Spirit.'

minorprophets.q: What did the prophet Haggai urge the people to rebuild?
minorprophets.explain: Haggai 1:8 says to build the house, the temple.

minorprophets.q: Malachi 3:10: 'Bring all the tithes into the ___.'
minorprophets.explain: Malachi 3:10 says to bring all the tithes into the storehouse.

minorprophets.q: Against which city was the prophet Nahum's message directed?
minorprophets.explain: Nahum 1:1 is 'the burden of Nineveh.'

minorprophets.q: In Joel's book, what insects devour the land?
minorprophets.explain: Joel 1:4 describes the locust swarming over the land.

minorprophets.q: Whom does Malachi say God will send before the great day of the LORD?
minorprophets.explain: Malachi 4:5 promises Elijah the prophet.

minorprophets.q: In Zechariah 9:9, what animal does Zion's King ride?
minorprophets.explain: Zechariah 9:9 says he is lowly and riding on a donkey.

minorprophets.q: Which is the first book of the Minor Prophets?
minorprophets.explain: Hosea opens the twelve Minor Prophets (Hosea 1:1).

minorprophets.q: Habakkuk 3:18: 'Yet I will ___ in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.'
minorprophets.explain: Habakkuk 3:18 says 'I will rejoice in the LORD.'

minorprophets.q: Jonah was the son of whom?
minorprophets.explain: Jonah 1:1 calls him 'the son of Amittai.'

minorprophets.q: Who was governor of Judah when Haggai prophesied?
minorprophets.explain: Haggai 1:1 addresses Zerubbabel, governor of Judah.

minorprophets.q: Which prophet wrote, 'Out of Egypt I called my son'?
minorprophets.explain: Hosea 11:1 contains that line.

minorprophets.q: Peter quoted which prophet at Pentecost about the Spirit being poured out?
minorprophets.explain: Peter quoted Joel 2:28 in Acts 2; the prophecy is in Joel 2:28.

minorprophets.q: From which town was Amos, according to his book's opening?
minorprophets.explain: Amos 1:1 says he was among the herdsmen of Tekoa.

minorprophets.q: Which prophet says the LORD will rejoice over you with singing?
minorprophets.explain: Zephaniah 3:17 says he will rejoice over you with singing.

minorprophets.q: In Habakkuk 1:6, which people does God say he is raising up?
minorprophets.explain: Habakkuk 1:6: 'I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation.'

minorprophets.q: Zechariah was the son of whom?
minorprophets.explain: Zechariah 1:1 calls him the son of Berechiah.

minorprophets.q: Nahum is described as belonging to which town?
minorprophets.explain: Nahum 1:1 calls him the Elkoshite.

minorprophets.q: Obadiah's message against Edom speaks of the house of which man?
minorprophets.explain: Obadiah 1:6 speaks of the things of Esau.

gospels.q: In which town was baby Jesus born?
gospels.explain: Joseph and Mary went to Bethlehem, where Jesus was born (Luke 2:4-7).

gospels.q: Where did Mary lay baby Jesus to sleep?
gospels.explain: Mary laid him in a manger because there was no room in the inn (Luke 2:7).

gospels.q: Who was the mother of Jesus?
gospels.explain: The angel told Mary she would bear a son and call him Jesus (Luke 1:30-31).

gospels.q: Who were the first to hear the angels' good news that a Savior was born?
gospels.explain: Angels announced the Savior's birth to shepherds watching their flocks (Luke 2:8-11).

gospels.q: Who followed a star to find and worship the young Jesus?
gospels.explain: Wise men from the east saw his star and came to worship him (Matthew 2:1-2).

gospels.q: What gifts did the wise men bring to Jesus?
gospels.explain: They opened their treasures and gave gold, frankincense and myrrh (Matthew 2:11).

gospels.q: Who baptized Jesus in the Jordan River?
gospels.explain: Jesus came to John to be baptized in the Jordan (Matthew 3:13).

gospels.q: What did Jesus turn into wine at a wedding in Cana?
gospels.explain: The servants had drawn water, and the master tasted it as wine (John 2:9).

gospels.q: What food did a boy share that Jesus used to feed 5,000 people?
gospels.explain: A boy had five barley loaves and two small fish (John 6:9).

gospels.q: What amazing thing did Jesus do on the Sea of Galilee that scared the disciples?
gospels.explain: Jesus came to the disciples walking on the sea (Matthew 14:25).

gospels.q: When Jesus said "Peace, be still" to the storm, what happened?
gospels.explain: The wind ceased and there was a great calm (Mark 4:39).

gospels.q: Which friend of Jesus did He raise from the dead after four days?
gospels.explain: Jesus called "Lazarus, come forth," and he came out (John 11:43-44).

gospels.q: Which short man climbed a sycamore tree to see Jesus?
gospels.explain: Zacchaeus ran ahead and climbed a sycamore tree to see Jesus (Luke 19:4).

gospels.q: Jesus said, "I am the good ___."
gospels.explain: Jesus said, "I am the good shepherd" (John 10:11).

gospels.q: What animal did Jesus ride into Jerusalem while crowds cheered?
gospels.explain: The King came riding on a donkey (Matthew 21:5).

gospels.q: What did Jesus say to let the little children do?
gospels.explain: Jesus said, "Let the little children come to me" (Mark 10:14).

gospels.q: How many close helpers (disciples) did Jesus choose as apostles?
gospels.explain: Jesus chose twelve of his disciples and named them apostles (Luke 6:13).

gospels.q: What wonderful thing happened to Jesus on the third day after He died?
gospels.explain: The angels said, "He is risen," as he had said (Luke 24:6-7).

gospels.q: Which woman did Jesus first appear to after He rose from the dead?
gospels.explain: Jesus appeared first to Mary Magdalene (Mark 16:9).

gospels.q: What came down like a dove when Jesus was baptized?
gospels.explain: Jesus saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove (Matthew 3:16).

gospels.q: Jesus said the poor in spirit will receive what?
gospels.explain: "Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven" (Matthew 5:3).

gospels.q: Jesus said the meek will inherit what?
gospels.explain: "Blessed are the meek, for they shall inherit the earth" (Matthew 5:5).

gospels.q: "Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called ___."
gospels.explain: Peacemakers shall be called children of God (Matthew 5:9).

gospels.q: What is the prayer that Jesus taught, beginning "Our Father", called?
gospels.explain: Jesus taught, "Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name" (Matthew 6:9).

gospels.q: "Where your treasure is, there your ___ will be also."
gospels.explain: Jesus said, "Where your treasure is, there will your heart be also" (Matthew 6:21).

gospels.q: "For God so loved the world ... that whoever believes in him should not ___, but have eternal life."
gospels.explain: Whoever believes in him should not perish but have eternal life (John 3:16).

gospels.q: In the parable of the lost son, what job did the younger son take in the far country?
gospels.explain: He was sent into the fields to feed pigs (Luke 15:15).

gospels.q: In the parable of the Good Samaritan, who stopped to care for the beaten man?
gospels.explain: The priest and Levite passed by, but a Samaritan had compassion (Luke 10:31-33).

gospels.q: In the parable of the lost sheep, how many sheep did the shepherd leave to search for the one?
gospels.explain: He leaves the ninety-nine to find the one that is lost (Luke 15:4).

gospels.q: Which disciple was a tax collector when Jesus called him?
gospels.explain: Jesus saw Matthew sitting at the tax office and said, "Follow me" (Matthew 9:9).

gospels.q: Which two fishermen brothers were the sons of Zebedee?
gospels.explain: Jesus saw James and John, sons of Zebedee, mending nets (Matthew 4:21).

gospels.q: Which disciple betrayed Jesus?
gospels.explain: Judas Iscariot went to the chief priests to betray Jesus (Matthew 26:14-16).

gospels.q: Which disciple denied knowing Jesus three times?
gospels.explain: The Lord turned and looked at Peter, who remembered his three denials (Luke 22:61).

gospels.q: How much money did the chief priests pay Judas to betray Jesus?
gospels.explain: They counted out thirty pieces of silver (Matthew 26:15).

gospels.q: At which place did Jesus pray the night before His arrest?
gospels.explain: Jesus went with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane to pray (Matthew 26:36).

gospels.q: What happened right after Jesus' baptism in Matthew?
gospels.explain: After his baptism, Jesus was led into the wilderness to be tempted (Matthew 3:16-4:1).

gospels.q: For how long did Jesus fast in the wilderness before being tempted?
gospels.explain: He fasted forty days and forty nights (Matthew 4:2).

gospels.q: Which Pharisee came to Jesus by night and was told he must be born again?
gospels.explain: Nicodemus came to Jesus by night and heard about being born again (John 3:1-3).

gospels.q: In the parable of the talents, how many talents did the servant who received the most get?
gospels.explain: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one (Matthew 25:15).

gospels.q: Where did Jesus perform His first miracle, turning water into wine?
gospels.explain: This beginning of miracles Jesus did in Cana of Galilee (John 2:11).

gospels.q: "In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with ___."
gospels.explain: John 1:1 says the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

gospels.q: Which Gospel opens with the genealogy of Jesus, beginning with Abraham?
gospels.explain: Matthew begins with the book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, son of Abraham (Matthew 1:1-2).

gospels.q: Which Gospel begins, "In the beginning was the Word"?
gospels.explain: John 1:1 opens that Gospel with the Word.

gospels.q: Which Roman governor handed Jesus over to be crucified?
gospels.explain: The Jewish leaders delivered Jesus to Pontius Pilate the governor (Matthew 27:2, 26).

gospels.q: "I am the way, the truth, and the ___."
gospels.explain: Jesus said, "I am the way, the truth, and the life" (John 14:6).

gospels.q: What did Jesus offer the Samaritan woman at Jacob's well?
gospels.explain: Jesus said he would have given her living water (John 4:10).

gospels.q: What does John 11:35 say Jesus did at Lazarus's tomb?
gospels.explain: John 11:35 records, "Jesus wept."

gospels.q: In Luke 1, whom did the angel Gabriel visit first?
gospels.explain: Gabriel spoke to Zechariah first (Luke 1:19), then to Mary in the sixth month (Luke 1:26).

gospels.q: Who sang, "My soul magnifies the Lord," a song known as the Magnificat?
gospels.explain: Mary said, "My soul magnifies the Lord" (Luke 1:46).

gospels.q: At the Last Supper, what act of humble service did Jesus perform for His disciples?
gospels.explain: Jesus poured water and began to wash the disciples' feet (John 13:5).

gospels.q: Which disciple said he would not believe in the resurrection until he saw the nail marks?
gospels.explain: Thomas said he would not believe unless he saw the nail marks (John 20:25).

gospels.q: To which village were two disciples walking on resurrection day when Jesus joined them?
gospels.explain: Two were going to Emmaus when Jesus drew near and walked with them (Luke 24:13-15).

acts.q: At Pentecost, who filled the believers while tongues of fire rested on each one?
acts.explain: Tongues like fire rested on each believer and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit (Acts 2:3-4).

acts.q: At Pentecost, what sound came from heaven before the Spirit came?
acts.explain: A sound like a rushing mighty wind filled the house (Acts 2:2).

acts.q: Who was set free from prison by an angel?
acts.explain: An angel of the Lord appeared in Peter's cell and led him out (Acts 12:7).

acts.q: When the angel came to Peter in prison, what fell off his hands?
acts.explain: The chains fell off Peter's hands when the angel woke him (Acts 12:7).

acts.q: Which servant girl was so happy that Peter was at the door that she forgot to open it?
acts.explain: Rhoda recognized Peter's voice and ran in with joy (Acts 12:13-14).

acts.q: On the road to Damascus, what did Saul see from heaven?
acts.explain: A light from heaven shone around Saul on the road (Acts 9:3).

acts.q: Saul, who met Jesus on the Damascus road, was later called by what name?
acts.explain: Saul, who is also called Paul, is named Paul from Acts 13:9.

acts.q: Whom did Philip meet in a chariot on the desert road?
acts.explain: Philip met an Ethiopian official riding in his chariot (Acts 8:27).

acts.q: Which prophet's scroll was the Ethiopian reading in his chariot?
acts.explain: The Ethiopian was reading the prophet Isaiah (Acts 8:28).

acts.q: After Philip told him about Jesus, what did the Ethiopian do in the water?
acts.explain: Philip baptized the Ethiopian when they came to some water (Acts 8:38).

acts.q: At midnight in the Philippi prison, what did Paul and Silas do?
acts.explain: Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God at midnight (Acts 16:25).

acts.q: Finish the verse: "Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be ___."
acts.explain: Paul and Silas told the jailer to believe and be saved (Acts 16:31).

acts.q: Which kind woman, who made clothes for the poor, did God raise up through Peter's prayer?
acts.explain: Peter prayed and Tabitha (Dorcas) opened her eyes and sat up (Acts 9:36-41).

acts.q: Finish the verse: "You will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you, and you will be my ___."
acts.explain: Jesus promised power to be His witnesses to the ends of the earth (Acts 1:8).

acts.q: Who was the first Christian martyr, stoned for his faith?
acts.explain: Stephen was stoned while praying 'Lord Jesus, receive my spirit' (Acts 7:59-60).

acts.q: About how many people were added to the church on the day of Pentecost?
acts.explain: About three thousand souls were added that day (Acts 2:41).

acts.q: Who was chosen to take Judas's place among the twelve apostles?
acts.explain: The lot fell on Matthias and he was counted with the eleven (Acts 1:26).

acts.q: Which man, nicknamed 'Son of Encouragement,' sold a field and gave the money to the apostles?
acts.explain: Joseph, called Barnabas, laid the money from his field at the apostles' feet (Acts 4:36-37).

acts.q: In which city were the disciples first called Christians?
acts.explain: The disciples were first called Christians at Antioch (Acts 11:26).

acts.q: Which Roman centurion in Caesarea sent for Peter and heard the gospel?
acts.explain: Cornelius, a devout centurion, was told by an angel to send for Peter (Acts 10:1-3).

acts.q: Whom did Paul choose as his partner for his second missionary journey?
acts.explain: Paul chose Silas and set out, commended by the believers (Acts 15:40).

acts.q: Which seller of purple cloth in Philippi had her heart opened by the Lord to listen to Paul?
acts.explain: Lydia, a seller of purple, listened as the Lord opened her heart (Acts 16:14).

acts.q: What words did Paul find written on an altar in Athens?
acts.explain: Paul used the altar inscription 'To the unknown god' to preach about the true God (Acts 17:23).

acts.q: On which island did Paul and his shipmates land after the shipwreck?
acts.explain: After the shipwreck they learned the island was called Malta (Acts 28:1).

acts.q: What creature fastened onto Paul's hand at the fire on Malta, without harming him?
acts.explain: A viper fastened on Paul's hand and he shook it off into the fire (Acts 28:3-5).

acts.q: Which young man fell asleep in a window and fell down while Paul preached late into the night?
acts.explain: Eutychus fell from the third story while Paul talked on, and was restored (Acts 20:9-12).

acts.q: Which Gospel writer also wrote the book of Acts?
acts.explain: Acts continues 'the former treatise' about all that Jesus began to do, written by Luke to Theophilus (Acts 1:1).

acts.q: In a vision at Troas, whom did Paul see begging 'Come over and help us'?
acts.explain: A man of Macedonia pleaded for help, so Paul crossed over to Macedonia (Acts 16:9).

acts.q: To whom is the book of Acts addressed?
acts.explain: Acts opens by addressing Theophilus (Acts 1:1).

acts.q: What issue did the Jerusalem Council address?
acts.explain: The council met over whether Gentile believers must be circumcised (Acts 15:1-2).

acts.q: Which respected Pharisee advised the Sanhedrin to leave the apostles alone?
acts.explain: Gamaliel warned the council not to fight against what might be of God (Acts 5:34-39).

acts.q: Which Roman proconsul on Cyprus believed after Paul struck the sorcerer Elymas blind?
acts.explain: The proconsul Sergius Paulus believed, astonished at the Lord's teaching (Acts 13:6-12).

acts.q: Which proconsul of Achaia refused to judge the charges brought against Paul in Corinth?
acts.explain: Gallio dismissed the case as a matter of their own law (Acts 18:12-16).

acts.q: Which learned Jew from Alexandria was taught the way of God more accurately by Priscilla and Aquila?
acts.explain: Priscilla and Aquila took Apollos aside and explained the way more fully (Acts 18:24-26).

acts.q: How many people were aboard the ship that was wrecked on the way to Rome?
acts.explain: There were 276 persons on the ship, and all reached land safely (Acts 27:37, 44).

acts.q: Which of these events happened first in the book of Acts?
acts.explain: Pentecost (Acts 2) comes before Stephen's stoning (Acts 7), the Council (Acts 15) and the shipwreck (Acts 27).

paul.q: In the armour of God, what is the sword of the Spirit?
paul.explain: Ephesians 6:17 says the sword of the Spirit is the word of God.

paul.q: Which of these is a fruit of the Spirit?
paul.explain: Galatians 5:22 lists love, joy, peace and more as the fruit of the Spirit.

paul.q: In God's armour, what do we wear around our waist like a belt?
paul.explain: Ephesians 6:14 says to stand with the belt of truth around your waist.

paul.q: In God's armour, what is the shield that stops the enemy's flaming arrows?
paul.explain: Ephesians 6:16 says to take up the shield of faith.

paul.q: In God's armour, what is the helmet?
paul.explain: Ephesians 6:17 says to take the helmet of salvation.

paul.q: Finish the verse: 'Love is patient, love is ___.'
paul.explain: 1 Corinthians 13:4 says love is patient and kind.

paul.q: Ephesians 4:32 says to be what to one another?
paul.explain: Ephesians 4:32 says to be kind and tenderhearted to one another.

paul.q: Who does Ephesians 6:1 say children should obey?
paul.explain: Ephesians 6:1 says children should obey their parents in the Lord.

paul.q: Philippians 4:4 says to do what in the Lord always?
paul.explain: Philippians 4:4 says to rejoice in the Lord always.

paul.q: Finish the verse: 'Rejoice always, ___ without ceasing.'
paul.explain: 1 Thessalonians 5:16-17 says to rejoice always and pray without ceasing.

paul.q: What kind of giver does God love?
paul.explain: 2 Corinthians 9:7 says God loves a cheerful giver.

paul.q: In God's armour, our feet are ready with the good news of what?
paul.explain: Ephesians 6:15 speaks of feet fitted with the readiness of the gospel of peace.

paul.q: What should we put on to stand against the devil's schemes?
paul.explain: Ephesians 6:11 says to put on the whole armour of God.

paul.q: Which letter of Paul describes the armour of God?
paul.explain: The armour of God is in Ephesians 6:11-17.

paul.q: Which of these is a fruit of the Spirit listed in Galatians 5?
paul.explain: Galatians 5:23 ends the list with gentleness and self-control.

paul.q: Finish the verse: 'For all have sinned, and fall short of the ___.'
paul.explain: Romans 3:23 says all fall short of the glory of God.

paul.q: According to Romans 6:23, the wages of sin is what?
paul.explain: Romans 6:23 says the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life.

paul.q: Finish the verse: 'For by grace you have been saved through ___.'
paul.explain: Ephesians 2:8 says we are saved by grace through faith.

paul.q: Finish the verse: 'All things work together for ___ to those who love God.'
paul.explain: Romans 8:28 says all things work together for good to those who love God.

paul.q: According to Romans 10:9, what must you confess with your mouth?
paul.explain: Romans 10:9 says to confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord.

paul.q: Finish the verse: 'Do not be conformed to this world, but be ___ by the renewing of your mind.'
paul.explain: Romans 12:2 calls us to be transformed by the renewing of our mind.

paul.q: Which short letter of Paul is a personal appeal on behalf of Onesimus?
paul.explain: Philemon 1:10 is Paul's appeal for Onesimus.

paul.q: According to 1 Corinthians 13:13, which is the greatest of faith, hope and love?
paul.explain: 1 Corinthians 13:13 says the greatest of these is love.

paul.q: According to 2 Timothy 3:16, all Scripture is given by inspiration of whom?
paul.explain: 2 Timothy 3:16 says all Scripture is God-breathed.

paul.q: In Galatians 2:20, Paul says he has been crucified with whom?
paul.explain: Galatians 2:20 begins, 'I have been crucified with Christ.'

paul.q: According to Philippians 2:10, what will bow at the name of Jesus?
paul.explain: Philippians 2:10 says at the name of Jesus every knee should bow.

paul.q: In the armour of God, what is the breastplate?
paul.explain: Ephesians 6:14 names the breastplate of righteousness.

paul.q: Finish the verse: 'Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for ___, not for human masters.'
paul.explain: Colossians 3:23 says to work as for the Lord.

paul.q: What does 1 Timothy 4:12 say not to let anyone look down on?
paul.explain: 1 Timothy 4:12 says let no one despise your youth.

paul.q: According to Romans 5:8, while we were still what did Christ die for us?
paul.explain: Romans 5:8 says while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

paul.q: Finish the verse: 'Let us not grow ___ in doing good, for in due season we shall reap.'
paul.explain: Galatians 6:9 says not to grow weary in doing good.

paul.q: Which of Paul's letters comes first in the New Testament?
paul.explain: Romans, opening with Romans 1:1, is the first of Paul's letters in the Bible.

paul.q: Who names himself as the one who wrote down the letter to the Romans for Paul?
paul.explain: Romans 16:22: 'I Tertius, who wrote this letter, greet you.'

paul.q: In Philippians 2:7, Christ took the form of what?
paul.explain: Philippians 2:7 says He took the form of a servant.

paul.q: In Romans 1:16, what does Paul say he is not of the gospel?
paul.explain: Romans 1:16: 'I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ.'

paul.q: On which day does 1 Corinthians 15:4 say Christ was raised?
paul.explain: 1 Corinthians 15:4 says He rose again the third day.

paul.q: In 1 Corinthians 12, the church is compared to what?
paul.explain: 1 Corinthians 12:12 compares Christ and the church to one body with many members.

paul.q: What did the Lord tell Paul was sufficient for him?
paul.explain: 2 Corinthians 12:9: 'My grace is sufficient for you.'

paul.q: In Philippians 4:11, what has Paul learned in whatever state he is?
paul.explain: Philippians 4:11 says he learned to be content.

paul.q: In Ephesians 5:25, husbands are told to love their wives as Christ loved whom?
paul.explain: Ephesians 5:25 says Christ loved the church and gave Himself for her.

paul.q: In which letter does Paul write, 'I have fought the good fight, I have finished the course'?
paul.explain: 2 Timothy 4:7 contains these words.

paul.q: Colossians 1:15 calls Christ the image of whom?
paul.explain: Colossians 1:15 says He is the image of the invisible God.

paul.q: 2 Thessalonians 3:10 says if anyone will not work, neither shall he do what?
paul.explain: 2 Thessalonians 3:10: if any would not work, neither should he eat.

paul.q: What does 1 Timothy 6:10 call a root of all kinds of evil?
paul.explain: 1 Timothy 6:10 says the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.

generalrev.q: Jesus says, "Behold, I stand at the door and ___."
generalrev.explain: In Revelation 3:20 Jesus stands at the door and knocks.

generalrev.q: Who will wipe away every tear from our eyes in heaven?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 21:4 says God will wipe away every tear.

generalrev.q: Finish the verse: "God is ___."
generalrev.explain: 1 John 4:8 tells us that God is love.

generalrev.q: "Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and ___."
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 13:8 says Jesus is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

generalrev.q: If we need wisdom, whom does James say we should ask?
generalrev.explain: James 1:5 says to ask God, who gives generously.

generalrev.q: According to 1 Peter 5:7, why can we give our worries to God?
generalrev.explain: 1 Peter 5:7 says to give God our worries because he cares for you.

generalrev.q: "If we confess our sins, God will ___ us."
generalrev.explain: 1 John 1:9 promises that God forgives us when we confess our sins.

generalrev.q: Which book is the very last book of the Bible?
generalrev.explain: Revelation ends the Bible, closing at Revelation 22:21.

generalrev.q: What were the streets of the city of heaven made of?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 21:21 says the street of the city was pure gold.

generalrev.q: What was each of the twelve gates of the new city made of?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 21:21 says each gate was made of a single pearl.

generalrev.q: Who built an ark by faith to save his family?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:7 says Noah by faith built an ark.

generalrev.q: Who obeyed God by faith and went out not knowing where he was going?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:8 says Abraham obeyed and went out not knowing where he was going.

generalrev.q: Which hero of faith refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:24 says Moses refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter.

generalrev.q: By faith, the walls of which city fell after the Israelites marched around them for seven days?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:30 says the walls of Jericho fell by faith.

generalrev.q: Which woman in Hebrews 11 welcomed the spies in peace and was spared?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:31 says Rahab welcomed the spies and did not perish.

generalrev.q: According to Hebrews 11, who was taken from this life so that he did not experience death?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:5 says by faith Enoch was taken so that he did not see death.

generalrev.q: James says, "Faith without ___ is dead."
generalrev.explain: James 2:17 says faith by itself, if it has no works, is dead.

generalrev.q: James compares which small part of the body to a fire that can set a forest ablaze?
generalrev.explain: James 3:5-6 says the tongue is a small part but is like a fire.

generalrev.q: James says to consider it pure joy whenever you face what?
generalrev.explain: James 1:2 says to count it joy when you face trials of many kinds.

generalrev.q: "Resist the devil, and he will ___ from you."
generalrev.explain: James 4:7 promises the devil will flee when we resist him.

generalrev.q: Abraham was called what of God?
generalrev.explain: James 2:23 says Abraham was called the friend of God.

generalrev.q: "I saw a new heaven and a new ___."
generalrev.explain: Revelation 21:1 says John saw a new heaven and a new earth.

generalrev.q: By faith, which son did Abraham offer up when God tested him?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 11:17 says Abraham offered up Isaac.

generalrev.q: Peter says the devil prowls around like what kind of animal?
generalrev.explain: 1 Peter 5:8 says the devil prowls around like a roaring lion.

generalrev.q: Hebrews 12:2 tells us to fix our eyes on whom?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 12:2 says to fix our eyes on Jesus.

generalrev.q: "We love because he first ___ us."
generalrev.explain: 1 John 4:19 says we love because God first loved us.

generalrev.q: How many churches are addressed in the letters of Revelation 2 and 3?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 1:11 sends the message to seven churches in Asia.

generalrev.q: The Lord says, "I am the Alpha and the ___."
generalrev.explain: Revelation 1:8 says, "I am the Alpha and the Omega."

generalrev.q: On which island was John when he received the revelation?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 1:9 says John was on the island of Patmos.

generalrev.q: Hebrews says Jesus is a priest forever in the order of whom?
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 5:6 says Jesus is a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.

generalrev.q: Which church was told it had forsaken its first love?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 2:4 tells the church in Ephesus it left its first love.

generalrev.q: Which church was rebuked for being neither hot nor cold?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 3:16 rebukes Laodicea as lukewarm.

generalrev.q: What name is given to the holy city John saw coming down out of heaven from God?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 21:2 calls it the holy city, the new Jerusalem.

generalrev.q: Which archangel is said to have disputed with the devil about the body of Moses?
generalrev.explain: Jude 1:9 names the archangel Michael.

generalrev.q: John writes that we have what with the Father in Jesus Christ the righteous?
generalrev.explain: 1 John 2:1 says we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ.

generalrev.q: In Revelation 5:5, Jesus is called the Lion of which tribe?
generalrev.explain: Revelation 5:5 calls him the Lion of the tribe of Judah.

generalrev.q: Peter calls believers "a royal ___."
generalrev.explain: 1 Peter 2:9 calls believers a royal priesthood.

generalrev.q: "The word of God is living and active, sharper than any two-edged ___."
generalrev.explain: Hebrews 4:12 says God's word is sharper than any two-edged sword.

Genesis 1:1.theme: God created the heavens and the earth
Genesis 1:1.web: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
Genesis 1:1.kjv: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

Genesis 1:27.theme: People are made in God's image
Genesis 1:27.web: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.
Genesis 1:27.kjv: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

Genesis 50:20.theme: God turns what was meant for evil into good
Genesis 50:20.web: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to bring to pass, as it is today, to save many people alive.
Genesis 50:20.kjv: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

Exodus 14:14.web: Yahweh will fight for you, and you shall be still.”
Exodus 14:14.kjv: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.

Exodus 20:12.web: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
Exodus 20:12.kjv: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

Leviticus 19:18.web: “‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am Yahweh.
Leviticus 19:18.kjv: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD.

Numbers 6:24.kjv: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:

Deuteronomy 6:5.theme: Love the LORD with all your heart
Deuteronomy 6:5.web: You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
Deuteronomy 6:5.kjv: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.

Deuteronomy 31:6.theme: Be strong and courageous; God goes with you
Deuteronomy 31:6.web: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them; for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”
Deuteronomy 31:6.kjv: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

Deuteronomy 6:4.theme: The LORD our God is one
Deuteronomy 6:4.web: Hear, Israel: Yahweh is our God. Yahweh is one.
Deuteronomy 6:4.kjv: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD:

Joshua 1:9.theme: Be strong and courageous; God is with you
Joshua 1:9.web: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.”
Joshua 1:9.kjv: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

Joshua 1:8.theme: Meditate on God's Word day and night
Joshua 1:8.web: This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it; for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.
Joshua 1:8.kjv: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.

Joshua 24:15.web: If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve Yahweh.”
Joshua 24:15.kjv: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.

Ruth 1:16.web: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God.
Ruth 1:16.kjv: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:

1 Samuel 16:7.web: But Yahweh said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I don’t see as man sees. For man looks at the outward appearance, but Yahweh looks at the heart.”
1 Samuel 16:7.kjv: But the LORD said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the LORD seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.

1 Samuel 17:47.theme: The battle belongs to the LORD
1 Samuel 17:47.web: and that all this assembly may know that Yahweh doesn’t save with sword and spear; for the battle is Yahweh’s, and he will give you into our hand.”
1 Samuel 17:47.kjv: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD’S, and he will give you into our hands.

1 Samuel 15:22.web: Samuel said, “Has Yahweh as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying Yahweh’s voice? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to listen than the fat of rams.
1 Samuel 15:22.kjv: And Samuel said, Hath the LORD as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the LORD? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.

1 Kings 3:9.theme: Asking God for an understanding heart
1 Kings 3:9.web: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this great people of yours?”
1 Kings 3:9.kjv: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?

1 Chronicles 16:34.theme: Give thanks; God's love endures forever
1 Chronicles 16:34.web: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
1 Chronicles 16:34.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.

2 Chronicles 7:14.theme: Humble yourself, pray, and turn to God
2 Chronicles 7:14.web: if my people, who are called by my name, will humble themselves, pray, seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then I will hear from heaven, will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
2 Chronicles 7:14.kjv: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

2 Chronicles 16:9.theme: God strengthens those whose hearts are loyal to Him
2 Chronicles 16:9.web: For Yahweh’s eyes run back and forth throughout the whole earth, to show himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. You have done foolishly in this; for from now on you will have wars.”
2 Chronicles 16:9.kjv: For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars.

Nehemiah 8:10.theme: The joy of the LORD is your strength
Nehemiah 8:10.web: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is prepared, for today is holy to our Lord. Don’t be grieved, for the joy of Yahweh is your strength.”
Nehemiah 8:10.kjv: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.

Esther 4:14.theme: Called for such a time as this
Esther 4:14.web: For if you remain silent now, then relief and deliverance will come to the Jews from another place, but you and your father’s house will perish. Who knows if you haven’t come to the kingdom for such a time as this?”
Esther 4:14.kjv: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father’s house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?

Psalm 23:1.theme: The LORD is my shepherd and provider
Psalm 23:1.web: Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.
Psalm 23:1.kjv: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

Psalm 23:4.theme: God is with me in the darkest valley
Psalm 23:4.web: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
Psalm 23:4.kjv: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

Psalm 27:1.theme: The LORD is my light, so I need not fear
Psalm 27:1.web: Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
Psalm 27:1.kjv: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

Psalm 46:1.theme: God is a present help in trouble
Psalm 46:1.web: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
Psalm 46:1.kjv: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

Psalm 119:105.web: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
Psalm 119:105.kjv: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

Psalm 121:1-2.theme: My help comes from the LORD
Psalm 121:1-2.web: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from? My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
Psalm 121:1-2.kjv: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.

Psalm 118:24.theme: Rejoice in the day the LORD has made
Psalm 118:24.web: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
Psalm 118:24.kjv: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

Psalm 19:1.web: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
Psalm 19:1.kjv: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

Proverbs 3:5-6.theme: Trust the LORD and He directs your paths
Proverbs 3:5-6.web: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
Proverbs 3:5-6.kjv: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

Proverbs 22:6.theme: Train up a child in the right way
Proverbs 22:6.web: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
Proverbs 22:6.kjv: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.

Proverbs 18:10.theme: The name of the LORD is a strong tower
Proverbs 18:10.web: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
Proverbs 18:10.kjv: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

Ecclesiastes 3:1.theme: There is a season for everything
Ecclesiastes 3:1.web: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
Ecclesiastes 3:1.kjv: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:

Isaiah 9:6.theme: A child is born: Wonderful Counselor, Prince of Peace
Isaiah 9:6.web: For to us a child is born. To us a son is given; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful, Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
Isaiah 9:6.kjv: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.

Isaiah 26:3.theme: Perfect peace for a mind fixed on God
Isaiah 26:3.web: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
Isaiah 26:3.kjv: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.

Isaiah 40:31.theme: Those who wait on the Lord renew their strength
Isaiah 40:31.web: But those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
Isaiah 40:31.kjv: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.

Isaiah 41:10.theme: Fear not, for God is with you
Isaiah 41:10.web: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
Isaiah 41:10.kjv: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.

Isaiah 43:2.theme: God is with us through water and fire
Isaiah 43:2.web: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.
Isaiah 43:2.kjv: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.

Isaiah 53:5.theme: The Servant wounded for our sins
Isaiah 53:5.web: But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed.
Isaiah 53:5.kjv: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

Jeremiah 29:11.theme: God's plans for hope and a future
Jeremiah 29:11.web: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.
Jeremiah 29:11.kjv: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.

Jeremiah 33:3.theme: Call to God and He will answer
Jeremiah 33:3.web: ‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’
Jeremiah 33:3.kjv: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.

Lamentations 3:22-23.theme: God's mercies are new every morning
Lamentations 3:22-23.web: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
Lamentations 3:22-23.kjv: It is of the LORD’S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

Ezekiel 36:26.theme: God gives a new heart and a new spirit
Ezekiel 36:26.web: I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.
Ezekiel 36:26.kjv: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.

Micah 6:8.theme: What the LORD requires: justice, mercy, and humility
Micah 6:8.web: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
Micah 6:8.kjv: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

Micah 5:2.theme: The ruler to come from Bethlehem
Micah 5:2.web: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings out are from of old, from ancient times.
Micah 5:2.kjv: But thou, Bethlehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.

Joel 2:28.theme: God's Spirit poured out on all people
Joel 2:28.web: “It will happen afterward, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh; and your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your old men will dream dreams. Your young men will see visions.
Joel 2:28.kjv: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:

Habakkuk 2:4.theme: The just shall live by faith
Habakkuk 2:4.web: Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.
Habakkuk 2:4.kjv: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the just shall live by his faith.

Habakkuk 3:18.theme: Rejoicing in the LORD whatever happens
Habakkuk 3:18.web: yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
Habakkuk 3:18.kjv: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.

Zechariah 4:6.theme: Victory comes by God's Spirit, not our strength
Zechariah 4:6.web: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is Yahweh’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says Yahweh of Armies.
Zechariah 4:6.kjv: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the LORD unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the LORD of hosts.

Malachi 3:10.web: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house, and test me now in this,” says Yahweh of Armies, “if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there will not be room enough for.
Malachi 3:10.kjv: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the LORD of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.

Zephaniah 3:17.theme: The LORD rejoices over His people with singing
Zephaniah 3:17.web: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
Zephaniah 3:17.kjv: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.

Nahum 1:7.theme: The LORD is good, a stronghold in trouble
Nahum 1:7.web: Yahweh is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.
Nahum 1:7.kjv: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.

Jonah 2:2.theme: God hears our cry from the depths
Jonah 2:2.web: He said, “I called because of my affliction to Yahweh. He answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried. You heard my voice.
Jonah 2:2.kjv: And said, I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the LORD, and he heard me; out of the belly of hell cried I, and thou heardest my voice.

John 3:16.theme: God's great love and the gift of eternal life
John 3:16.web: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
John 3:16.kjv: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

John 14:6.theme: Jesus is the way, the truth, and the life
John 14:6.web: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
John 14:6.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

Matthew 6:33.web: But seek first God’s Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
Matthew 6:33.kjv: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

Matthew 11:28.web: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
Matthew 11:28.kjv: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

Matthew 28:19.web: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
Matthew 28:19.kjv: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:

Luke 2:11.web: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.
